title: COURTSIDE CHAOS: 3D anime fight
prompt_text:
Seedance 2.5 Prompt:
Create a 30-second cinematic 3D anime action-comedy fight titled COURTSIDE CHAOS.
Use the uploaded combined character sheet as the strict visual reference for both characters. Preserve their exact appearances, body proportions, outfit colors, facial structures, accessories, and weapon design throughout the entire clip.

CHARACTERS:
Character 1 is Panda Flip, a stylish streetwear panda fighter with a relaxed, playful, effortlessly confident personality. He is always calm, never intimidated, and fights using smooth dance-like footwork, unpredictable agility, perfect timing, and playful basketball tricks. His expressions remain cool, cheeky, and slightly mischievous.
Character 2 is Brute Jaw, a massive shark-headed street brute with an enormous expressive face, thick neck, broad muscular torso, no tail, and intimidating physical presence. He is aggressive, impatient, extremely competitive, and increasingly furious every time Panda humiliates him. His only weapon is his signature giant street sledgehammer, which must remain identical throughout.

STYLE: Premium cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, Unreal Engine-quality rendering, thick expressive black outlines, bold color blocking, crisp hard-edge shadows, subtle hand-painted textures, vibrant daylight colors, sharp anime impact frames, controlled motion blur, expressive character animation, exaggerated squash-and-stretch reactions, and dynamic cinematic camera movement. The final video should feel like a high-budget stylized anime fighting-game cinematic with hilarious physical comedy, impressive fighting choreography, and polished visual storytelling. Not photorealistic, not flat 2D.

FORMAT: 16:9 widescreen / 30 seconds / 4K-quality detail / Fast, clean, readable choreography / No dialogue / No subtitles / No voice-over / No text overlays / No watermarks.

SETTING: A beautiful outdoor urban basketball court on a bright summer afternoon. Brilliant blue sky, scattered white clouds, warm golden sunlight, colorful painted court markings, two basketball hoops at opposite ends, chain-link fencing, a low concrete seating bench, distant apartment buildings, and a few leafy trees beyond the fence. One orange basketball is on the court. The near hoop has a thick padded support pole. Keep the location, hoop positions, court markings, shadows, and props consistent throughout. The entire fight happens on this empty basketball court. No spectators, no additional characters, no neon lighting, no nighttime atmosphere.

ACTION TIMELINE:
0:00 to 0:03 — Open with a dramatic low-angle tracking shot of Brute Jaw marching onto the sunny basketball court, dragging his enormous sledgehammer across the painted ground. He aggressively slams it onto the court, creating a dramatic dust burst and thin surface cracks. Cut to Panda Flip standing near the three-point line, casually spinning the orange basketball on one finger. He looks at Brute Jaw, raises one eyebrow, and gives a playful little shrug.
0:03 to 0:06 — Brute Jaw charges and swings his giant hammer horizontally toward Panda. Panda instantly bends backward in an effortless limbo-style dodge while keeping the basketball balanced on his fingertip. The hammer sweeps just above his face. Panda straightens up, spins around Brute Jaw with smooth dance-like footwork, and lightly taps the shark's shoulder from behind. Brute Jaw turns around furiously, but Panda has already moved away.
0:06 to 0:09 — Brute Jaw launches an enormous overhead hammer strike. Panda suddenly drops into a low basketball dribble, slips sideways beneath the incoming attack, and bounces the ball between Brute Jaw's legs. The hammer crashes into the court behind Panda with a huge anime impact burst. Panda catches the returning basketball after it bounces off the ground behind Brute Jaw and immediately performs a smooth behind-the-back dribble. Brute Jaw looks completely confused.
0:09 to 0:12 — Brute Jaw roars and lunges forward with a massive punch while holding his hammer in his other hand. Panda effortlessly pivots around the punch and performs a flashy crossover dribble. Brute Jaw overcommits, stumbles forward, and barely catches his balance. Panda casually shoots the basketball toward the near hoop. Cinematic low-angle tracking shot follows the ball through the bright blue sky. It drops perfectly through the net with a clean swish. Brute Jaw turns and sees Panda celebrating with a tiny shoulder dance.
0:12 to 0:15 — The basketball lands beneath the hoop and bounces back onto the court. Brute Jaw angrily rushes toward Panda, swinging his hammer in a wide circular attack. Panda slides backward on his feet, narrowly avoiding the first swing, then casually steps sideways as the second swing passes him. Brute Jaw's momentum carries him toward the padded basketball support pole. His hammer strikes the thick padding with a loud rubbery thump. The pole vibrates, the hoop shakes, and Brute Jaw recoils with a ridiculous stunned expression. Panda catches the bouncing basketball nearby.
0:15 to 0:18 — Brute Jaw becomes even more furious. He lifts the hammer overhead and charges straight toward Panda for another devastating strike. Panda dribbles toward him, suddenly plants one foot, and performs a spectacular basketball spin move. Brute Jaw swings downward but completely misses. Panda slips around his side, plants both feet, and springs upward into an exaggerated slow-motion anime basketball jump. For one glorious second, Panda appears suspended against the brilliant blue sky, holding the ball in one hand.
0:18 to 0:21 — Dynamic camera follows Panda as he flies toward the near basketball hoop. He performs a spectacular one-handed slam dunk. BOOM. The rim flexes and rebounds realistically. The basketball shoots through the net and bounces onto the court. Panda releases the rim immediately, twists gracefully in midair, and lands in a perfect superhero-style crouch. Brute Jaw watches with his mouth wide open, furious and completely speechless.
0:21 to 0:24 — Brute Jaw charges again with one final aggressive hammer attack. Panda calmly retrieves the bouncing basketball and turns toward him. At the last second, Panda performs a sudden sideways basketball fake, moving the ball across his body. Brute Jaw instinctively follows the movement, swings too wide, and loses his balance. His feet scramble comically across the painted court as he tries desperately to stop himself.
0:24 to 0:27 — Brute Jaw staggers backward toward the low concrete bench at the court's edge. His hammer drops safely onto the ground beside the bench. He falls backward into a seated position on the bench with an enormous comedic thump. The bench stays intact. A small puff of dust rises around him. Close-up on Brute Jaw's enormous face. His eyes widen, his mouth falls open, and his expression changes from rage to pure humiliation. Panda casually walks into frame, spinning the basketball on one finger.
0:27 to 0:30 — Panda stops several steps in front of the seated Brute Jaw. With a cheeky grin, he lightly tosses the basketball toward Brute Jaw. Brute Jaw instinctively catches it against his chest, surprised. Panda points toward the basketball hoop, makes a playful shooting gesture with his hands, and gives a confident wink. Brute Jaw looks at the basketball, then at Panda, completely bewildered. Panda turns around and casually moonwalks away across the sunlit court. End on a beautiful wide cinematic shot with Panda dancing away in the foreground and the defeated shark sitting on the bench holding the basketball.

CAMERA: Use continuously varied premium anime action cinematography. Dramatic low-angle hero shots, energetic side-tracking shots, punchy close-ups on facial expressions, sweeping basketball follow-cams, fast whip pans, dynamic ground-level perspectives, brief slow-motion moments, and spectacular wide shots. Every major attack must have clear setup, movement, impact, and reaction. Keep both fighters spatially consistent. Avoid confusing teleportation, disconnected attacks, or unnecessary camera spins. Give the basketball dunk one strong cinematic slow-motion moment before returning to fast-paced action.

AUDIO: Energetic cinematic anime action-comedy soundtrack with funky electric bass, punchy hip-hop drums, playful brass accents, dramatic percussion, and comedic rhythmic breaks. Detailed sound effects: hammer dragging, court cracking, basketball dribbling, sneaker squeaks, powerful whooshes, metallic vibrations, bouncing ball, basketball net swishes, rim flexing, exaggerated comedic thumps, and crisp anime impact accents. The music should build during the fight, peak during Panda's spectacular slam dunk, and end with a playful comedic flourish. No spoken dialogue.

CONSISTENCY RULES: Exactly two characters only. One continuous outdoor basketball court. Bright afternoon daylight throughout. Use the uploaded character sheet as the absolute visual reference. Panda Flip's outfit, sunglasses, body proportions, and facial design must remain identical. Brute Jaw must retain his original enormous shark head, massive physique, and no tail. Only one basketball exists throughout the video. Its trajectory, bounces, and position must remain physically coherent. Brute Jaw has exactly one sledgehammer. No additional weapons. The sledgehammer remains in Brute Jaw's hands until he drops it beside the bench during the final sequence. The basketball hoop, court layout, and bench must remain in fixed positions. Panda must never appear frightened, injured, or exhausted. Brute Jaw must never appear seriously injured. No blood, no gore, no dismemberment. No magical powers, teleportation, energy blasts, or supernatural effects. No random props or background characters. No sudden visual style changes. Use exaggerated but readable anime physics. The comedy must come from Panda's effortless confidence, clever basketball moves, Brute Jaw's embarrassing mistakes, and the contrast between overwhelming strength and perfect timing. Make the fight incredibly entertaining, visually spectacular, funny, and easy to follow from beginning to end.

title: HyperFrames product announcement video
prompt_text: Create a 15-second product announcement with animated titles, three feature highlights and a final call to action.
